questions.stem: A 5-year-old child is brought to the clinic with a history of chronic productive cough, recurrent respiratory infections, and poor weight gain despite an adequate diet. Additionally, the parents report that the child's sweat is very salty. Which of the following sets of clinical features would most likely indicate the diagnosis?

options.label: A
options.text: Bronchial asthma, nasal polyps, and aspirin intolerance

options.label: B
options.text: Chronic sinusitis, meconium ileus in infancy, and rectal prolapse

options.label: D
options.text: Frequent diarrhea, poor weight gain, and recurrent otitis media
